evidence.description: s00 reads the raw corpus and term list, matches corpus filenames to EIGHTK_META, and skips parsing when the raw directory is absent.
evidence.quote:
def main():
    with Step("s00_parse_press_releases", C.LOG_FILE) as log:
        if not os.path.isdir(C.CORPUS_DIR):
            log.milestone(f"Raw press-release corpus not found at {C.CORPUS_DIR!r}; skipping re-parse.")
            return

        log.milestone("Loading the IR-domain term list")
        ir_terms = _load_terms(C.DISS_TEXT_TERMS_FILE)

        log.milestone("Mapping corpus files to their 8-K filing locations via eightk_meta")
        ek = pd.read_parquet(C.EIGHTK_META, columns=["OUTFILE_LOCATION", "FILE_LOCATION"])
        ek["base"] = ek["OUTFILE_LOCATION"].map(os.path.basename)
        base2fl = dict(zip(ek["base"], ek["FILE_LOCATION"].astype(str)))

        files = sorted(os.listdir(C.CORPUS_DIR))
        pairs = [(b, base2fl[b]) for b in files if b in base2fl]
        skipped = len(files) - len(pairs)
        log.milestone(f"Parsing {len(pairs):,} press-release files "
                      f"({skipped:,} on disk had no filing-metadata match and are skipped)")

"""Fama-French 48 industry classification.

Maps a firm's four-digit SIC code to its Fama-French 48 industry. Unmatched SIC codes fall in the
"Other" industry (48); a missing SIC yields a missing industry. Ranges are checked in order, last match wins.
Ranges follow Kenneth French's published industry definitions (Data Library).
"""
